OPERATOR RULING (recorded verbatim, attributed to the operator): "Unreadable config should result in an error."

The ruling issued on loveydovey-preoceanic-geese (39f8-ae7c) applies to this ticket's MCP surface too: an unreadable/corrupt rebar.toml must raise a loud error, not silently resolve gates to their defaults. So the approach here changes from 'distinguish the states, keep the safe fail direction' to 'surface the error per MCP error conventions' — config.mcp_readonly() / config.mcp_gate() must not swallow ConfigError into a default; the MCP resolvers must surface the config fault to the caller. Description will be updated with the revised design before claim, after the gate_enabled half (39f8-ae7c) lands.
